_about: What each area teaches (decision 576, Jeff's 'companions learn everything ... each area adds capability'): a capability is a mark on a player's record (record.marks) or a companion's (record.companion["marks"]) with an entry here. Capabilities reads it; Main.grant_capability gives one to the players and their companions who earned it, Main.party_has asks whether a player or the companion with them holds one (a level link sealed by it opens for either). Keys: words (its name, in her voice and on her card), area and teacher (lore's), holders (player, companion or both), status (live: given and checked; draft: no area yet, nothing gives or checks it), companion_line (the party log when she takes it; {her} her name), fact (on her card; {her}, {player}), bond and bond_why (her bond event, 555's table), gates (what it opens, by kind: sealed, air, craft, fight).

draugr.fact: {her} went down into the barrow with {player} and laid the draugr to rest.
draugr.bond_why: laid the draugr to rest with you

rot_ward.companion_line: The elves teach {her} the rot ward too.
rot_ward.fact: {her} learned the rot ward from the elves, beside {player}.
rot_ward.bond_why: learned the rot ward with you
gates: sealed: the deeper Blood Rot caverns
